vīcus

vīcus, vīcī m.

noun, second declension

block, street; a street lined with houses, in a town; a village; village

In this lexicon

  • block

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 173

  • road

    also used · classical · Cic. Mil. 64; Hor. Ep. 1.20.18 (Lewis & Short)

  • village

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 207, 402

Examples

  • per vīcum, ubi canēs quemque praetereuntem lātrant

    through the village, where the dogs bark at everyone who passesLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae
